parameters.text: No imagery could be retrieved: imagery_window returned 'not_allowed: this task has no imagery source' for both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs. No candidate was visually verified; existence and warehouse-vs-factory/market/hangar distinction are unconfirmed. Embedding index is synthetic (aef-10m-annual, fixture, 160 m cells, 3430 cells, 10 m signal pooled), so cells are ~ the size of a warehouse and do not resolve single buildings. Few-shot retrieval used 16 PLATEAU building training examples (not specifically warehouses), only top 60 cells returned; only 25 cells at score>=0.8 were aggregated into 24 isolated sites (nearly all single-cell). The remaining ~3400 cells (~87 km2 incl. area counted as unreviewed by aggregate) were not reviewed. Count range: low 6 (sites with score>=0.87), high 24; true count not established, treat as unvalidated candidates only. Stopping because no further evidence source is available.
